messages:
tara: FYI Northstar Capital added a clause in their PO: tamper-evident audit exports, tenant legal-hold API, and retention lanes (3/7/10 yrs). They want pilot acceptance criteria before signing.

micah: Key Q - BYOK required now? procurement said optional for pilot; security asked for an archived, signed ledger per export.

sophie: From compliance: acceptance should include (1) verifiable hash chain across chunks, (2) legal-hold toggle that prevents GC and records an audit event, (3) export verification steps the customer can run.

infra-bot: Current exporter: nightly incremental, unsigned, strips some request-trace metadata. Estimated full-tenant export time: ~40m per TB unthrottled. Chunking + index adds ~12% storage overhead.

micah: Proposal: Pilot (MVP) scope = signed manifest + hash-chain, tenant legal-hold toggle, export verification checklist, and a pilot runbook. BYOK/KMS integration is Phase 2 (target Q1 next year).

tara: Pilot acceptance criteria (draft) - please react if OK: 1) export manifest includes tenant_id, export_time, chunk_index, chunk_digest, cumulative_digest, signer_id, signature; 2) customer can verify signature + cumulative_digest using docs; 3) legal-hold API toggles retention and emits audit events visible in Console; 4) exports complete within 2h for tenants <2TB; 5) runbook exists with throttling knobs.

sophie: I'll map those to SOC2/ISO controls and confirm which controls are satisfied by MVP vs Phase 2 BYOK.

micah: Minimal manifest example we'll sign (MVP):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "northstar-001",
  "export_id": "exp-2026-05-14T03:22:00Z",
  "chunk_index": 7,
  "chunk_digest": "sha256:4b8f...",
  "cumulative_digest": "sha256:9a2c...",
  "signer_id": "redwood-exports@redwood.ai",
  "signature": "base64(...)"
}
```

tara: Ops/security note: implement signing as a pluggable step so we can swap signer to BYOK later with minimal migration. Also need key-rotation guidance for platform keys and contract language for interim platform-signed acceptance.

infra-bot: Suggested implementation plan: persist provenance fields in ETL (1 sprint), add signing step + signature verification test harness (1 sprint), add legal-hold flag + Console UI (0.5 sprint), update export runner for chunking + index (0.5 sprint). Total ~3 dev-sprints across teams.

sophie: Legal: platform-signed bundles acceptable for pilot with explicit contract note; BYOK required for final procurement. I'll draft the clause and the evidence mapping.

micah: Pilot runbook plan: onboard 1 pilot customer (Northstar) + 2 internal tenants, 4-week pilot, collect export time, verification pass-rate, and storage delta. If metrics OK, schedule BYOK work in Q1.

tara: Action items: @micah open CR with manifest schema + pilot checklist; @sophie map controls + draft contract clause by Tue; @infra-bot (infra) share low-level data-model diffs and PR estimate by EOD. We'll review during priority grooming.

legal-bot: Reminder: please file compliance-ticket with customer name, retention lanes, manifest schema link, and BYOK preference.

micah: CR-404 opened and attached manifest example + draft runbook. Will update with perf numbers after infra estimate.

tara: Thanks all. Keep this thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
